role: saved-state diagnostic of earlier replenishment timing, not a new causal policy or weekly performance estimate
registration_context: four absolute-dispatch pilots observed; neither admitted run fulfilled all requests, both first deficits at minute 420; the earlier-PN intervention has not been replayed

commands.nomination_MW: use the stored original command for each profile

roster.request_marks: reuse only the original export marks at minutes 360 and 420, and their unchanged absolute peaks; do not change signs or draw a new sequence
roster.initial_exposure: execute locked reference at minutes 330--360; at 360 begin a 120-minute replay with the following locked PN and the nominated PN for 390; no prior accepted pulse is active
roster.subsequent_control: after the one nominated slot, use the unchanged nominate_units and unit_planning_terms with original targets, receipts and 60-minute lead
roster.asset_and_tolerance: retain both 98 MWh stocks, gross 98 MW, 0.92 efficiencies, and the original 1e-8 tolerance; no capacity or target search
roster.outcomes: first physical or known commitment failure, both request completion counts, signed executed-prefix errors, stock extrema and PN records
roster.baseline_requirement: the retained branch must reproduce the saved raw failures at absolute minutes 428 and 439; a mismatch blocks interpretation

intervention_scope: the single command is chosen after observing the depleted unit; it is a diagnostic intervention within the legal nomination lead, not evidence that a causal controller would choose it
decision: if an earlier nomination avoids the first deficit without another physical or commitment failure, develop and freeze a causal rule based only on pre-nomination information; otherwise diagnose the retained physical constraint. In neither case expand the weekly matrix or claim service reliability from these short replays
preservation: retain every old product, policy and negative result; write timing fixtures to a separate directory
limitations: two post-hoc states and one fixed command on one observed export--export pair cannot establish an operational policy, future request coverage or the original 95 percent development criterion
